personality_one_liner: A warm, highly accessible, and tactile shared family budget designed with oversized elements and clear contrast for users of all tech literacy levels.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Touch targets minimum 56pt. Padding is large to prevent mis-taps. Elements feel chunkier and more distinct.

dont's: Avoid glassmorphism to preserve high contrast and readability for elderly users. Rely on solid colors and clear boundaries.

screens.name: Resumo (Home)
screens.purpose: A highly visual dashboard showing the total balance, month selector, and a breakdown of 'where the money goes' via large tactile cards.

states.loading: Centered large spinner with text 'Carregando resumo...'
states.empty: Illustration of a piggy bank with text 'Nenhum lançamento neste mês. Vamos começar?' and a big 'Adicionar' button.
states.error: Illustration of a broken cable with 'Ocorreu um erro ao carregar os dados' and a 'Tentar Novamente' button.

screens.layout: Header: Large Month/Year selector pill. Hero: A massive, highly legible card showing 'Saldo do Mês' in a huge font (2xl), colored green if positive, red if negative. Below hero: A 2-column grid of oversized, touch-friendly cards for 'Renda Total', 'Despesas Fixas', 'Despesas Variáveis' using distinctive icons (e.g., money, home, shopping cart) inside brandTertiary tinted circles. At the bottom: 'Para onde vai o dinheiro' bar chart or stacked progress bar for visual breakdown. A giant floating action button (FAB) anchored bottom right for quick entry.

screens.name: Lançamentos (Extract)
screens.purpose: A linear, deeply simplified list of all incomes and expenses for the selected month, grouped intuitively.

states.loading: Skeleton rows with large circular avatar placeholders and thick title placeholders.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty receipt with 'Tudo limpo por aqui!'
states.error: Error icon with 'Não conseguimos carregar os lançamentos.'

screens.layout: Top: Segmented control or horizontal scroll of large filter chips (Todas, Rendas, Fixas, Variáveis). Body: A list where each row has a minimum height of 72pt. Each row features a large colored icon container (green for income, warm/red for expense), the category name in heavy text, the person who logged it (avatar), and the value aligned right. No tiny metadata; keep text >16pt everywhere.

screens.name: Família (Members)
screens.purpose: Management of family members, their avatars, and their fixed monthly incomes.

states.empty: Should always have at least the logged-in user. Illustration of an empty house to invite.

screens.layout: Top: A hero card with a warm abstract texture and a 'Código de Convite' displayed in massive mono font. Body: A vertical stack of member cards. Each card contains a real photo avatar (64x64), the member's name, and their 'Renda Mensal' (Monthly Income). An 'Editar Renda' primary pill button sits on each card. Bottom: 'Adicionar Membro' full-width button.

avatar_mother.alt: Portrait of a cheerful senior woman

avatar_daughter.alt: Portrait of a smiling young woman

hero_family_texture.alt: Warm crumpled beige parchment paper texture

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize extreme legibility. The target audience includes elderly users with low literacy. Base font size is 18pt. Do not use tiny metadata.
Do not rely solely on color to communicate state. Always pair color (e.g., green for positive, red for negative) with distinct icons (+ and - signs, arrows up/down).
Make all touch targets incredibly generous. Minimum height for list items is 72pt, buttons 56pt.
Disable glassmorphism completely. For older users, blur effects reduce contrast and legibility. Use solid surface layering with shadow_tier 2.
When displaying the family members, use the provided real photo avatars rather than initial-based placeholders to make recognition immediate.
The FAB must be oversized and permanently anchored above the tab bar. It should use 'brandPrimary' and be unmistakable as the main action button.
In the 'Família' screen, the invite code must be massive and easy to read (consider using mono font for the code only, ensuring characters like 'O' and '0' are distinct).
Implement the gradient scrim on any image background, such as the `hero_family_texture` on the members screen, to ensure text contrast is strictly maintained.
